verdict.rationale: Docs show a custom segment builder with unlimited conditions/filters, filtering by tags, segments, and date ranges (creation, update, last event, unsubscribe), plus an events API that tracks behavior and updates profile fields, which together let marketers build segments from attributes, tags, and events. However, no explicit documentation confirms segments dynamically re-evaluate in real time as new data/events arrive versus being static snapshots. Missing for 10: explicit real-time/live segment refresh confirmation, independent/hands-on verification of segment behavior.
